notes.title: Little (G)Patch
notes.content:
I have absolutely no idea why it took me so long to fix this..... ah right, I had no controller at home for months, so controller playtesting was impossible for a while.😅



Anyways, there was an issue preventing players from aiming diagonally while staying at a spot when the controller was connected. That have finally been fixed.



I forgot to mention it now, but the in-game cutscenes also went through a huge overhaul, resulting in a better image quality and pretty much no chances of a bug nor soft-lock anymore.



As for the increase in file size over these little updates.... please just ignore that.... for now, at least.😅🙏🏾



And now.... for the 'G' in the room.



Don't let your guard down around the Missing G. The Missing G ---is --real... -and --just--- around -the --corner.

Keep -that --in --mind.... The Missing G --shall --be ---Reborn.---



.........................................



Huh? What was that?



Anyways, as always, thanks for playing The InBetween! And to anyone discovering the game for the first time, really glad the game caught your interest, and I hope you enjoy the game as much as I really enjoy making it. :D



- VCD

notes.title: A little bit of Farewell.....
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023885/121b212e38b2c4935e065f5d6d149cc0eec42ef6.png

2024 was quite a year.

Went through a lot and managed to drop a much larger demo than anticipated.
And thanks to you all, the game managed to improve at an alarming rate.

However, 2025 is here... and it is finally time to move on towards actually finishing the game. Which is why Demo 3.0.0 will be the last major update to be made to the game's demo. Here's what have been done to it so far:

- Sprinkled bits and pieces of secrets here and there, I wonder who can find them all?

- Added a little bit of extra visual flair to the game, especially in the visual effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023885/b1256a917f18bc460c98947c8538ac4d734d9a10.png
- Fleshed out the three major endings in the demo, making it a truly unique experience based on which route you choose.

- Added Japanese localization to the game for Eastern audiences More might come soon.

- Fixed some more bugs, including one that caused a rare crash. (That one was painful to find. T-T)

And more content ranging from an extra Pixl mode battle to another area to explore (cuz the demo can't get large enough XD).

The demo will be updated from time to time should any unforeseen bug arrive, and there will be more updates on the game's progress than usual. 

In the meantime, I would like to thank you for taking the time to play this game of ours and for the feedback and suggestions offered. And I hope this farewell update will be just as enjoyable as the previous versions, or even much better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023885/375dad3ea9410b37e8c680a05f85bab7015619fa.png

Till next time! <3

- VCD

p.s. The cow was a lie.

notes.title: Demo Version 2.0.0 Launched!
notes.content:
Version 2.0.0 is here! Along with some improvements and changes!!!

- Complete overhaul and improvement of the game's Map(Tab to access).

-Improved Pipit's movement. As well as fine-tuned the dash!

-Added a teensy little bit of a new area to explore in anticipation for the full game.

-Removed another cow, before you say anything, don't ask.

-Replaced a few placeholders that got overlooked(my bad...)

-Added some extra scenes to add to the game's current story and LOOORE!!!

-Added a link to the game's crowdfunding page. (You can check it out if you want👀)

-Fixed issues with the gamepad controls.

-Fixed framerate issues affecting the game, especially at Twilight Grove!
An eternity later...

Whew!! That's all of it! 
Thank you so much for playing the game in its early stages and for the feedback.

And I hope you enjoy the latest update!😁
*Of course, if anything should by chance, go wrong, feel free to let me know and drop a review and I'll respond faster than Reverse Flash going after Barry.😅

Thanks for playing and for the reviews in advance!! <3

- VCD
